messages:
toni: flagged by CS — multiple CI deploy jobs failing with 401s right after key rotation window. customer: zeta-corp. started around 03:07 UTC.
infra-bot: alert -> 401 Unauthorized: signed_jwt validation failed (KMS_SIGN_ERROR) x12 in 3m
maya: which SA are we seeing this for? service-account name?
toni: ci-service@zeta-corp. It looks tied to the scheduled KMS key rotation we kicked at 03:05 UTC.
devops: I pulled a snippet from runner-proxy logs: ```2026-04-02T03:06:11Z WARN proxy request id=job-9a4b sign attempt failed: KMS error: KeyVersion "v5" disabled
2026-04-02T03:06:11Z ERROR proxy request id=job-9a4b respond 401 "signed_jwt validation failed"
2026-04-02T03:06:12Z INFO proxy request id=job-9a4b retry signing via fallback cache -> miss
2026-04-02T03:06:12Z ERROR proxy request id=job-9a4b respond 401 "KMS sign error: KeyVersionNotFound"
```
leah: interesting — our key rotation job marks older versions disabled before enabling the new one for a few seconds while it finishes activation in the HSM cluster. if runners cached the old key version reference they might still try to sign with v4 which is disabled.
sam: runners don't store private keys locally; they request sign operations from KMS with an explicit key version id we pass through the SA signing lib. the signing lib resolves the key version from metadata cached for 3s. we may have a race where the rotation writes new metadata and disables old version in KMS, but some proxies still reference disabled id and get KeyVersionNotFound.
kate: are failures all immediate post-rotation? or are they sporadic after?
toni: mostly within the first 2 minutes post-rotation, spike of 10-15% job failures in parallel deploys. single-run jobs rarely fail.
maya: reproduction steps proposed:
- deploy 6 self-hosted GH runners
- trigger the key rotation playbook (kms-rotate-key --key ci-service-signing)
- simultaneously run ./ci/deploy --concurrency 6 --repeat 30
- observe 401s with KMS sign errors in proxy logs

devops: confirmed in staging exactly as described; saw KeyVersion disabled errors for a short window.
leah: quick mitigation: temporarily re-enable previous key version to allow signed_jwt ops to complete, or pause rotation rollout for CI-critical projects until we deploy a tolerant signing flow.
sam: short term patch: change signing client to fall back on newest ENABLED key version if requested version is disabled, and add exponential backoff with 250-1000ms jitter on sign calls. I'll open a hotfix.
kate: long term: rotate keys with a dual-active mode — enable new version first then disable old after a grace period; or use key aliases so callers don't reference explicit versions. add a CI-aware rotation policy that delays disable for 5 minutes for CI-linked projects.
maya: docs: add runbook steps for KMS rotations + CI (include query to list active versions and a quick rollback command). also add an alert that monitors KeyVersion state transitions and correlates with KMS_SIGN_ERROR spikes.
ops-bot: deploy started: proxy-signing-fallback v2026.04.02-hotfix -> staging
sam: pushed hotfix to staging with fallback logic and jitter; reran the staging smoke with rotation and 6 runners: 0% failures for 40 runs.
toni: customer update queued: explained root cause (race during KMS version disable), mitigation performed (re-enabled old version + hotfix), and ETA for prod rollout 20m.
devops: scheduled prod rollout; will monitor for any residual 401s and keep rollback plan ready (re-enable old key).
leah: follow-ups/tickets:
- INFRA-1703: implement key-alias abstraction in signing lib (avoid explicit version refs)
- INFRA-1704: CI rotation policy: grace window + alerting
- INFRA-1705: add integration test that simulates KMS version disable during signing
maya: added notes to support case and set reminder to check in 24h before closing.
toni: resolved: prod rollout completed, customer reports normal deploy success. will keep rotation schedule paused for CI-critical projects until dual-active rotations are in place. :white_check_mark:
